Porch Group, Inc., together with its consolidated subsidiaries, ("Porch," the "Company," "we," "our," "us") is a new kind of homeowners insurance company—one designed to stand out in a massive and growing market of more than $100 billion. Our strategy is built on three differentiators that set us apart.

Leveraging unique property insights, we can assess risk with greater precision, enabling competitive pricing for low-risk customers and avoiding high-risk customers, while delivering superior underwriting performance.
We are committed to being the go-to partner during one of life's most significant transitions—buying a home—by offering services that simplify moving and home setup.
We combine homeowners insurance with home warranty, filling coverage gaps and reducing unexpected costs for consumers.

In January 2025, we completed the formation of Porch Reciprocal Exchange (the "Reciprocal") and, as part of this process, sold our legacy homeowners insurance carrier, Homeowners of America ("HOA"), to the Reciprocal. Following the sale, HOA became a wholly owned subsidiary of the Reciprocal. Porch continues to manage and operate the Reciprocal, providing critical services such as underwriting, policy renewal, risk and portfolio management, financial oversight, and investment guideline setting. In return, Porch earns commissions and fees for these services.

Beyond insurance, Porch is a leader in the home software-as-a-service ("SaaS") space, serving approximately 24 thousand companies across industries essential to the home-buying process—home inspectors, title companies, mortgage providers, and more. Our deep relationships and proprietary data give us unique visibility into approximately 90% of U.S. homes, enabling superior risk assessment and competitive pricing.

Our mission is to be the best homeowners insurance partner for homebuyers, offering more than just coverage. Through the Porch app, we provide a full moving concierge service, helping customers with moving logistics and essential home services like security, TV/Internet setup, and more.

Finally, we deliver greater home protection by pairing homeowners insurance with full home warranty, additional coverages, and appliance recall monitoring. This approach fills coverage gaps, reduces unexpected costs, and strengthens our value proposition—creating deeper, lasting relationships with our customers.

Beginning in January 2025, we operate under four reportable segments that are also our operating segments. Three of these segments are owned by Porch — Insurance Services, Software & Data, and Consumer Services. We collectively call these three segments, along with corporate functions, the "Porch Shareholder Interest." Our fourth segment, the Reciprocal Segment, is managed, but not owned, by Porch and, at this time, is consolidated for reporting purposes.

Our Insurance Services segment earns management fees from the Reciprocal in exchange for managing and operating its business. This segment also receives policy fees from policyholders, lead fees from agencies, earns interest on surplus
notes from the Reciprocal, and includes a captive reinsurer to provide reinsurance support to improve capital efficiency for the Reciprocal.

We provide software, on a subscription and predominantly transactional basis, to inspection, mortgage, title, and roofing companies. This segment includes the Inspection Support Network ("ISN") collection of brands, which are leading SaaS solutions for inspectors with easy-to-use tools. ISN brands provide a range of offerings for inspection businesses, and together represent roughly half of all U.S. home inspections in 2025. Rynoh software helps settlement agents protect the real estate transaction. Rynoh software was utilized in approximately 40% of all real estate closings in 2025. Floify is a software company helping mortgage companies and loan officers create a better mortgage and refinancing experience for consumers. iRoofing provides measurement software for roofers.

Porch Group Media is a leading provider of data solutions, including Home Factors, our unique property insights product. With insights into approximately 90% of U.S. homes, Home Factors provides interior and exterior attributes and condition data to help insurance carriers improve underwriting, pricing, and risk selection. Beyond insurance, Home Factor property insights are utilized in other business areas to enhance customer acquisition and retention efforts.

Risks Relating to our Insurance Operations
paragraphs: The following summary risk factors and other information included in this Annual Report should be carefully considered. The summary risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem less significant may also affect our business operations or financial results. If any of the following risks actually occur, our stock price, business, operating results and financial condition could be materially adversely affected. For more information, see below for more detailed descriptions of each risk factor.
•Our brands and businesses, including the insurance business we manage, operate in an especially competitive and evolving industry.

•We face a variety of risks from our expansion into the insurance business, including as a result of higher than expected claims costs and other factors outside of our control, which may result in an adverse impact on the Company's financial condition.

•Porch Shareholder Interests and our future growth are largely dependent on our ability to manage the operations of and grow the insurance business we manage and operate by limiting attrition, generating surplus at the Reciprocal, and increasing our revenue by increasing the number of sales of home-related services per customer and consumer. We may not succeed in these efforts.

•The incidence, frequency and severity of weather events, extensive wildfires, and other catastrophes, particularly occurring where the Porch Reciprocal Exchange (the "Reciprocal") has a concentration of homeowners insurance policyholders, or that adversely impact consumer confidence and spending behavior in the industries we serve, could have a material effect on our results of operations and financial condition.

•Our efforts to develop new insurance products, expand in targeted insurance markets, improve business processes and workflows, use Home Factors in underwriting, or make acquisitions may not be successful and may create enhanced risk.

Key Performance Measures and Operating Metrics
Reciprocal Policies Written — We define Reciprocal Policies Written as the number of new and renewal insurance policies written during the period by the Reciprocal Segment.

RWP per Policy Written — We define RWP per Policy Written as the RWP in the period, which is reflective of the total amount a policyholder is expected to pay, divided by the Reciprocal Policies Written in the period.
Average Revenue per Monetized Service — We define Average Revenue per Monetized Service as total Consumer Services segment revenue generated in the period over the number of Monetized Services.

Porch Group, Inc., together with its consolidated subsidiaries, ("Porch," the "Company," "we," "our," "us") 是一家全新類型的住宅保險公司——一種在超過 100 十億美元的龐大且快速成長市場中脫穎而出的保險公司。我們的策略建立在三個不同點上，使我們與其他公司區別開來。
透過獨特的財產洞察力，我們可以更精準地評估風險，使低風險客戶能享有競爭性價格，並避免高風險客戶，同時提供優越的承保表現。
我們致力於成為人生中最重要的轉變之一——購屋過程中的首選夥伴，透過提供簡化遷移與住宅設置的服務。
我們將住宅保險與住宅保證合併，填補保障缺口並降低消費者意外支出。

2025 年 1 月，我們完成了 Porch Reciprocal Exchange（"Reciprocal"）的設立，並在這個過程中，將我們的傳統住宅保險電信業者 Homeowners of America（"HOA"）出售給 Reciprocal。出售後，HOA 成為 Reciprocal 的 wholly owned subsidiary。Porch 繼續管理並運作 Reciprocal，提供關鍵服務，如承保、保單續保、風險與投資組合管理、財務監督與投資指引設定。作為回報，Porch 會從這些服務中獲得佣金與費用。
除了保險，Porch 在住宅軟體即服務（"SaaS"）領域中為領導者，服務約 24 千家產業與購屋過程相關的公司——住宅檢查師、地權公司、房貸提供者等。我們深厚的關係與專屬資料，使我們對美國約 90% 的住宅擁有獨特的洞察力，從而實現優越的風險評估與競爭性價格。
我們的使命是成為購屋者的最佳住宅保險夥伴，提供不僅僅是保障。透過 Porch 應用程式，我們提供完整的遷移管家服務，協助客戶處理遷移物流與必要的住宅服務，如安全、電視/網路設置等。
最後，我們透過將房屋所有權保險與完整屋況保證、額外保障項目及電器產品回購監測結合，提供更完善的居家保護。此方式可填補保障缺口、降低意外支出，並強化我們的價值主張—建立更深入且持久的客戶關係。
自2025年1月起，我們以四個應報告分部運作，這些分部同時也是我們的營運分部。其中三個分部屬於Porch所有—保險服務、軟體與數據、以及消費者服務。我們 collectively 稱呼這三個分部，加上公司功能，為『Porch 股東權益』。我們的第四個分部，即互惠分部，由Porch管理但不擁有，目前為報表目的已合併入帳。
我們的保險服務分部從互惠分部收取管理費，作為管理及運作其業務的對價。此分部同時也從保單持有人收取保單費用、從經紀公司收取導入費用，並從盈餘中獲取利息收入
說明書中提及互惠制，並包含一家自設再保險公司，以提供再保險支援，以提高互惠制的資本效率。

我們提供軟體，主要以訂閱模式及交易性方式提供給檢測、房貸、產權及屋頂公司。此應報告分部包含 Inspection Support Network ("ISN") 品牌系列，這些品牌為檢測人員提供易於使用的工具，為領先的 SaaS 解決方案。ISN 品牌為檢測業務提供一系列的服務，合計約佔 2025 年美國住宅檢測業務的 50%。Rynoh 軟體協助過戶代理人保護不動產交易。Rynoh 軟體在 2025 年約有 40% 的不動產過戶交易使用。Floify 為協助房貸公司及貸款經理人為消費者創造更好的房貸與重新貸款體驗的軟體公司。iRoofing 提供屋頂工程師用以測量的軟體。
Porch Group Media 是提供數據解決方案的領導者，包括 Home Factors，我們獨特的不動產洞察產品。透過對約 90% 的美國住宅的洞察，Home Factors 提供室內與室外的屬性及狀態數據，協助保險電信業者改善核保、定價與風險選擇。除了保險領域，Home Factors 的不動產洞察數據亦應用於其他業務領域，以提升客戶獲取與留存的成效。

paragraphs: 下列摘要風險因素及其他資訊包含於本年度報告中，應謹慎考量。上述摘要風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為較不重要，也可能影響我們的業務運作或財務結果。若上述任何風險實際發生，可能對本公司股票價格、業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。如需更多資訊，請參閱下方對每個風險因素的詳細說明。
• 我們的品牌與業務，包括我們管理的保險業務，運作於一個特別競爭且不斷演進的產業。
• 我們在拓展保險業務時，面臨多種風險，包括因高於預期的賠償成本及其他我們無法控制的因素，這可能會對本公司財務狀況造成不利影響。
• Porch 股東權益與我們的未來成長， largely 依賴我們管理並運作所管理的保險業務的能力，包括限制人員流失、在 Reciprocal 產生盈餘，以及透過增加每位客戶與消費者購買住宅相關服務的數量來提高收入。我們可能無法成功達成這些目標。
• 天氣事件、廣泛的野火及其他災難的發生頻率與嚴重程度，特別是在 Porch Reciprocal Exchange（"Reciprocal"）擁有大量住宅保險被保險人的地區，或對我們所服務產業的消費者信心與消費行為造成不利影響，可能對我們的營運結果與財務狀況產生重大影響。
• 我們努力開發新保險產品、拓展目標保險市場、改善業務流程與作業流程、在核保中使用 Home Factors，或進行收購，可能無法成功，並可能增加風險。
